_note: Tropical Florida Keys sandbox (DESIGN.md section 3). Pure play, no scoring, nothing can be done wrong. Plants grow with days (GameClock); watering only speeds them up. Recipes with a 'wear' block go on the paper doll; the rest are just made, kept and enjoyed. A critter 'surprise' fires when the doll's outfit matches 'when' (first match wins; the entry without 'when' is every critter's default, so every outfit gets a delighted reaction). 'lines' are spoken as the critter's bubble through Voice.speak; 'names' are the critters' own names (set per placed critter as nickname).
